execution.primary_run_policy: Run once after source/plan commit. Preserve first outputs and any failures. No full-cell learning during development. Tiny deterministic numerical/fault fixtures are separately disclosed.
execution.truth_policy: Inference runner/CLI receives observations and public configuration only. Separate scorer loads truth after every inference process has finished.
execution.checkpoint: Fixed-size complete canonical state, no pointer/rawjournal. Warmrestore makes no numerical updates and preserves state/factor/config/counters exactly.
execution.cold: Restorecontrol900s then discardbelief and initialize the declared public prior while plant continues. Source position and known absoluteclock retained; no true hidden state.

acceptance.functional: Every declared process/delivery completes with explicit finite-state/ordering/lifecycle semantics; exact warmcheckpoint and queryparity excludingruntime timings. No silently lost physical updates or duplicated observation evidence.
acceptance.resource: No heap in inference kernel, no rawhistory, owned persistent/workspace/query bytes constant from first tolast observation; practical initial owned budget8192B before stack/runtime/persistence extras. Record all additional simultaneous costs.
acceptance.qualification: Report prior-conditioned localSD, excitation/reasons/constraints and actual point errors separately. Local2sigma widths are not a hard-error guarantee. Count hard-limit breaches among provisional savedqueries; report first/sustained and fraction unavailable/unresolved.
acceptance.comparison_reference: Frozen M1 outputs at samepositions, plus supplemental new-threshold and fullbelief audit. No rerun of M1 solver.
acceptance.decision: Keep as a candidate only if hard target/lifecycle/resource gates pass without hidden numerical faults; record preferred-region performance separately. If it fails, stop and name one measured cause for the next bounded change. Do not launch annual/attention/multistart experiments automatically.
